# The creation of Batman

Batman first appeared in Detective Comics #27 in 1939, a year after Superman. For decades the character was credited only to artist Bob Kane, but writer Bill Finger made major contributions, including the costume details, Bruce Wayne's name and much of Gotham City.

Finger received little recognition during his lifetime. In 2015, DC Comics began crediting Batman as "created by Bob Kane with Bill Finger".

Unlike Superman, Batman has no superpowers. He relies on his intelligence, detective skills, physical training and wealth. His origin, in which young Bruce Wayne sees his parents killed, was introduced in 1939 and has been retold many times.
